breakdown.description: The setup assumes inviscid flow but then includes viscous friction losses (Darcy–Weisbach).
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the core contradiction. The generated specification repeats the user's error by stating, 'The flow is assumed inviscid, but the Darcy–Weisbach equation is used...' The ground truth corrects this by explaining that if the flow is truly inviscid, friction losses are zero, or alternatively, one must assume the flow is viscous to use the Darcy-Weisbach equation. The agent did not make this logical correction and instead just restated the conflicting premises.
